generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
pageBody: Nothing you did caused this. Try reloading first; if it still fails, go back to the home page and come in again.
adminTitle: This admin page failed to load
adminBody: Usually the API answered in a shape this screen did not expect. Reloading normally clears it, and the other admin pages are unaffected.
notFoundBody: The address may have a typo, or the page may have moved. One of these usually picks up where you were going.
